=Write a short note from Spine to the founder of {{ $json.company }}. They've just posted a role in {{ $json.state }}: "{{ $json.job_title }}".

Use only this background, and don't claim to know anything else about the company:
{{ $json.rule_requirement }}

Three sentences. Friendly and specific, no hype, no emoji. Offer help with payroll setup in the new state. Don't suggest they've done anything wrong, and don't say it's their first hire there.
